channel_controls.linear_drift: gain multiplier linearly 0.8 to 1.2; background linearly 0 to 2
channel_controls.lognormal_AR1: stationary eta~N(0,0.04), AR coefficient 0.95; gain multiplier exp(eta-0.02), fixed background 1
channel_controls.sampling: counts conditionally independent Poisson given complete latent intensity and actual channel state; fixed calibration is violated by the channel controls

model.OU: exact stationary eigenmode transition: r=exp(-lambda*u), innovation variance=c/lambda*(1-r^2); no Euler discretization
model.count_reference: mu=10, one shared gain_on_J=mu/pooled nominal leading mean, reference background 1
model.edges: path plus chord (20,22) for A and (41,43) for B, zero-based indices
model.exposure: instantaneous snapshots only; integrated exposure not modeled
model.observable: J=|sum z_i expm1(i omega sqrt(beta)Y_i)|^2/beta, omega=pi/3; exact finite-beta null representation, ordinary floating arithmetic
model.phase: algebraic nominal exact-null construction, evaluated in float64
model.stationary_covariance: D=c L_weighted_plus, c=63/trace(nominal L_plus); fixed nominal scaling

numeric_controls: Nominal trace/q/p2 against retained exact enclosures within stated float tolerance; eigensystem/projector residuals; exact-null phase residual; stable vs direct amplitude comparison; matrix-exponential stationary covariance identity.
preservation: Verify the source manifest before running; exclusively create a fresh user-selected output directory. A source change is a new revision requiring a new manifest and replay.
purpose: Exercise exact finite-beta observable and diagnostic failure modes with deliberately generated signals. No physical-model validation or discrimination-error guarantee.
recording: All 16 scenario/class cells, source/model labels, every seed tuple, diagnostics, covariance matrices, numerical controls and compressed arrays of all 8192 frames; no selected-best-only reporting. All 62 nominally standardized motion modes are retained in this v2 release adaptation, allowing complete covariance/kurtosis replay.
scope: Deliberate stress cases and mu-derived gains can be outside the certified domain. Threshold flags are descriptive engineering diagnostics without calibrated false-alarm coverage. Self-generated data do not validate the assumptions used to generate them. Short-lag correlation can cause empirical covariance or kurtosis flags even for the correct stationary Gaussian generating law; flags are not causal diagnoses.
selection_disclosure: All eight scenarios and their seeds were retained from an earlier completed private pilot. This portable revision is validated by fresh runs; it is not a new preregistration.
supported_python: CPython >=3.11,<3.14; conventional builds with official wheels
